_what: How the words heard while recording are kept when one line is said again and again back to back (parts/record-audio/read-data/heard-words.mjs). A phrase of up to phrase_words_up_to words heard repeats_from times or more in a row is kept once; two phrases count as the same when at least same_share of their words match, so a misheard word in one copy does not break the run. A stretch whose three-word runs are less than distinct_share_min different (a line on repeat, not someone talking) is not handed to the person's AIs as work, once it holds at least judge_from_words words.
